outcome_schema: Each run outcome_prefix has arrays _index,_label,_terminal_correct and optionally _probability_mean_correct, shape(15,140); corruption order is corruptions and object order equals sealed cohort indices. Bootstrap original objects jointly over corruptions/heads/three fixed seeds; do not treat repeated events as independent.
probability_mean: float64 softmax each of four candidate logits at T=1; arithmetic mean probabilities, argmax. Last candidate terminal. See exact raw member names/hashes in historical_runs.
protocol_confounds: Candidate is original Chamfer B32 normal8/background35 eta=.003 gamma=.03 p=.95 original decoder finalalphaTrue; C/H host is B70 normal10/background30 eta=gamma=.01 updated decoder finalalphaFalse. Candidate minus historical C/H is a whole-policy comparison, not isolated depth/rate/loss causality.
Main H uses PointMAE semantic teacher; later Scan-only H uses CurveNet teacher and a different label-free calibrated coefficient. Keep both H phases and their own C controls separate.
Main and later C share input IDs/seeds but different source/process histories and native numerical variability. Equal seeds do not prove common random numbers across campaigns.
